request.prompt:
ONE single cartoon meme character, full body, centered, one body and one face, every part fused into the body and not pasted on, no collage. Base body: the huge black-furred silverback gorilla body of Harambe with long heavy arms reaching the ground and a flat grey saddle across the broad back. Head: the Shiba Inu head of Doge with small triangular upright ears, round fluffy cheek tufts, short muzzle and black nose, covered in the same black fur as the body. Eyes: Pepe the Frog's big round eyes with large white sclera and heavy half-closed sleepy-smug upper lids. Brows: Wojak's thin tilted sad worried eyebrows drawn above the lids on the grey brow ridge. Mouth: the enormous crooked Trollface grin with a full row of big white teeth stretching past the cheeks, with a few scribbly wrinkle folds at the corners. Jaw: Gigachad's extremely chiselled square jawline with sharp cheekbones and a short black trimmed beard, directly under the grin. Skin: all bare skin on face, brow, chest and palms is NPC Wojak's flat featureless grey with no shading. Feet: three short stocky black-furred legs in a wide tripod, each wearing a bright blue Nike-style sneaker with a white swoosh like Tralalero Tralala. Accessory: Tung Tung Tung Sahur's polished warm-brown wooden baseball bat with grain rings resting on one shoulder. Pose: the body in a slight three-quarter turn, the Shiba head cocked and turned back over the shoulder like Doge, one hand holding the bat, the other knuckles on the ground. Signature feature: the bearded Gigachad jaw with a Trollface grin on a Shiba-headed gorilla standing on three blue sneakers. One consistent palette of exactly five flat colours: black fur, flat grey skin and saddle, white teeth sclera and swooshes, bright blue sneakers, warm brown bat. Style: clean character illustration, confident thin black lineart, flat colours with at most minimal flat shading, chunky clean fur tufts, expressive face, solid single-colour pale yellow background; no shadows, no gradients, no lighting effects, no floor, no background elements, no text, no logos, no watermark.
